author: Fouled
body:
Recently Rage Inc has lost their server, due to some reasons like being expensive and stuff. We the people are asking any who has a server if we can use it for builds and more as we will give them credit. Rage inc is a wonderful building team and we plan on making maps for many servers. We just ask if someone can give us a server to use with world edit, voxel and ect. Thank you, and all of Rage Inc depends on you.
We need a server to use, thanks.
~ Slicorn - Rage Inc map dev

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
no I use hosthorde.

I did not discon-- okay I did.
But it was so much stress, and I was thinking about using the server for something else, scrimmage maybe even a public server.

"Recently Rage Inc has lost their server, due to some reasons like being expensive and stuff"
It's not expensive, actually it's really cheap and reliable. it was just stressful.  
But my 3 day vacation and the server getting destroyed while I was gone made me break my keyboard and resign as a server host.
I know the "group of people" who griefed it, and you know who you are also.

But if you need to host, I strongly recommend hosthorde unlimited.

-RI Tag thingy no idea why people are doing this server hosted kid lolbye
